investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell was invoked by trainerroad.exe to run Get-AuthenticodeSignature against a locally stored installer at C:\Users\t_doe\AppData\Local\trainerroad-updater\pending\temp-TrainerRoad-2026.4.2.386.exe, which indicates a signature verification step for an updater component. The initiating process is a user-level updater (trainerroad.exe) launched under explorer.exe, the process SHA256 is not found in VirusTotal, and there are no recent related events or alerts or external network indicators. These factors indicate behavior consistent with benign updater activity and insufficient evidence of malicious intent, so the alert is assessed as Low Priority.
